title: Preferred suppliers
intro: The supplier the request form fills first for each category, from an approved sourcing award or set by procurement. A requester may choose another but gives the reason.
riskIntro: A preferred supplier at risk still shows on the request form, but a requester who chooses another gives no reason. Procurement may end it.
forbidden: This account may not see the supplier register. Ask your organization admin if you need this page.
failed: The preferred suppliers could not be opened. Reload the page and try again.
sourcingOff: Sourcing is switched off, so no new preferred supplier can be set. Those set before still fill the request form until their last day, and can be ended early.

create.title: Set a preferred supplier
create.intro: The request form fills this supplier for the category throughout the period. A requester who chooses another gives the reason.
create.categoryHint: A category of the catalogue's items or of an RFx

end.reasonHint: At least {min} characters. Procurement, finance and auditors see it.

errors.SUPPLIER_UNKNOWN: This supplier is no longer in use or not in the register. Choose another supplier.

errors.PERIOD: The last day cannot be before the first day

errors.EXPIRED: This one's period is over already, so there is nothing to end.
